headline: Is Qualcomm Stock a Buy Ahead of July 29 Q3 Earnings?
summary: Qualcomm reports Q3 earnings on July 29 with Polymarket odds heavily favoring a beat, yet the stock still trades at a fraction of its chip rivals' valuations. Whether that gap closes depends on what management says about a pending hyperscaler launch and a handset business expected to hit bottom this quarter.
